nasa_description: Shows information related to hydroxylated minerals including phyllosilicate. Mg/Fe-OH bearing minerals may appear red, or magenta when hydrated. Al/Si-OH bearing minerals may appear green, or cyan when hydrated. Blue colors may indicate other hydrated minerals. See Viviano-Beck et al. [2014] for details. Analysis of CRISM spectra must be used to match absorption band positions and relative strength for positive mineral identification.
source: MRO CRISM Map-projected Targeted Reduced Data Record, browse product (NASA PDS Geosciences Node; JHU/APL)

ours.shift_note: Constant shift found by matching the CRISM true-colour browse product to the HiRISE base over this area (correlation 0.26 -> 0.78). One translation; residual not evaluated.
ours.gain_note: One brightness gain for all three bands, so hues are unchanged.
